## Service areas
- [Waxhaw, NC](https://agallowayscapes.com/areas/waxhaw-nc/): Union County. Waxhaw is home. Our trucks leave from here every morning, and most of the yards we take care of are a short drive from downtown.
- [Weddington, NC](https://agallowayscapes.com/areas/weddington-nc/): Union County. Weddington is known for big, wooded lots and long frontages. That changes how a property should be designed and maintained.
- [Marvin, NC](https://agallowayscapes.com/areas/marvin-nc/): Union County. Marvin’s homes are built to impress from the street. The landscape should keep up with the architecture.
- [Wesley Chapel, NC](https://agallowayscapes.com/areas/wesley-chapel-nc/): Union County. Wesley Chapel mixes family neighborhoods with rural land, so we see everything from quarter-acre lawns to open acreage.
- [Indian Trail, NC](https://agallowayscapes.com/areas/indian-trail-nc/): Union County. Indian Trail has grown fast, and a lot of its yards are still living with the shortcuts taken when the houses went up.
- [Monroe, NC](https://agallowayscapes.com/areas/monroe-nc/): Union County. Monroe, the Union County seat, has everything from historic homes near downtown to new subdivisions and open land on the edges of town.
- [Indian Land, SC](https://agallowayscapes.com/areas/indian-land-sc/): Lancaster County. Indian Land sits right across the state line from Waxhaw, and it’s one of the fastest-growing communities in the region.
- [Fort Mill, SC](https://agallowayscapes.com/areas/fort-mill-sc/): York County. Fort Mill’s neighborhoods are newer, tightly built and often sloped — a combination that makes grading and drainage the first thing to get right.
- [Tega Cay, SC](https://agallowayscapes.com/areas/tega-cay-sc/): York County. Tega Cay wraps around Lake Wylie, and many yards slope toward the water. Landscaping here has to hold the ground in place.
- [Rock Hill, SC](https://agallowayscapes.com/areas/rock-hill-sc/): York County. Rock Hill has some of the most established neighborhoods we serve — big trees, older beds and yards with a lot of character.

In Wesley Chapel, Fescue lawns should be aerated and overseeded in early fall. Bermuda lawns are aerated in early summer and usually aren’t overseeded.

- [How a French Drain Protects Your Home from Costly Water Damage](https://agallowayscapes.com/how-french-drain-protects-home-from-costly-water-damage/): A French drain protects your home by collecting water underground in a perforated pipe wrapped in gravel and carrying it away before it reaches the foundation. That keeps the soil around the house from staying saturated, which reduces foundation movement, damp crawlspaces and basement leaks.
